Three years of genocide.

Those four words - and the reality they represent - are hard to comprehend.

Of course, we know Israel acts with impunity and the unconditional support of
the U.S. and so many Western powers, but how can the world allow a
livestreamed genocide to happen - much less enter its fourth year?

Just in Gaza this week, the official death toll reached another grim
milestone, as Israeli strikes killed several, including another journalist.
Israel's genocidal actions are not limited to Gaza: Israel's extremist
national security minister threatened to execute a Palestinian prisoner,
Israeli settlers carried out more pogroms in the occupied West Bank, and
hundreds of Israelis stormed the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound.

Now, here's more on what happened just _this_ week in Palestine:

#### **Saturday, Sept. 26 - Official Death Toll in Gaza Surpasses 74,000**

The official death toll in Gaza from Israel's genocide topped 74,000, the
Palestinian Ministry of Health[ said](https://t.me/MOHMediaGaza/7633). The
death toll is likely much, much higher as thousands of bodies remain under the
rubble.

The death toll includes more than 1,400 who have been killed since the so-
called "ceasefire" last October.
